description: Configure Dynatrace API access token and personal access token generation. For details about tokens and authentication go to [Dynatrace API authentication documentation](https://dt-url.net/8543sda).

newDynatraceTokenFormatEnabled.displayName: Create Dynatrace API tokens in the new format
newDynatraceTokenFormatEnabled.description: Check out this [blog post](https://dt-url.net/ho02y5r) to find out more about the new Dynatrace API token format.

patEnabled.description:
Allow users of this environment to generate personal access tokens based on user permissions. 
 Note that existing personal access tokens will become unusable while this setting is disabled.
